# StarPDF v0.11 complex synthetic corpus

All PDFs in this directory are deterministic `SYNTHETIC_REGRESSION` fixtures generated by `examples/generate_v0_11_fixtures.rs`. They contain only synthetic text and placeholder structural bytes. They contain no personal documents, passwords, usable signatures, certificates, or private keys, and they do not count as independent producer coverage.

| Fixture | Structure | v0.11A role | Expected result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `synthetic-hybrid-multi-revision.pdf` | Classic xref with `/XRefStm`, xref stream, `/Prev`, later classic replacement, changed second `/ID` | Mixed-history precedence and effective trailer regression | PASS |
| `synthetic-metadata-rich.pdf` | `/Info`, XMP, language, viewer preferences, page mode/layout, open action, names, outlines, unknown catalog key | Unrelated incremental mutation preservation | PASS |
| `synthetic-ambiguous-orphan-radio.pdf` | Two same-name orphan radio widgets without structural group identity | Inspection succeeds; group mutation does not guess | REFUSED_SAFELY for group mutation |
| `synthetic-malformed-parent-radio.pdf` | Canonical radio field whose child widget points at a contradictory `/Parent` | `MALFORMED_FIELD_GRAPH` classification | REFUSED_SAFELY for group mutation |
| `synthetic-signature-field-only.pdf` | Unsigned signature widget/field | Interrupted broader-v0.11 structural fixture; outside v0.11A claim scope | PASS for inspection |
| `synthetic-signed-valid.pdf` | Structurally consistent signature dictionary and bounded `/ByteRange`; placeholder contents | Interrupted broader-v0.11 structural fixture; not cryptographically signed | PASS for structural inspection |
| `synthetic-signed-malformed.pdf` | Overlapping/unordered `/ByteRange` | Interrupted broader-v0.11 structural fixture | REFUSED_SAFELY |
| `synthetic-encrypted-standard.pdf` | Standard security-handler dictionary with synthetic fields | Interrupted broader-v0.11 structural fixture; no password or encrypted payload | REFUSED_SAFELY for mutation |
| `synthetic-encrypted-public-key.pdf` | Public-key security-handler metadata with placeholder recipient bytes | Interrupted broader-v0.11 structural fixture; no certificate or key | REFUSED_SAFELY for mutation |
| `synthetic-encrypted-malformed.pdf` | Trailer `/Encrypt` points to a non-dictionary object | Interrupted broader-v0.11 structural fixture | REFUSED_SAFELY for mutation |
| `synthetic-hybrid-signed-encrypted.pdf` | Hybrid xref, two revisions, inherited root/protection metadata, structural signature | Interrupted broader-v0.11 interaction fixture; outside v0.11A claim scope | REFUSED_SAFELY for mutation |

The v0.11A compatibility total is 33 meaningful PDFs: the established 22-fixture v0.9/v0.10 corpus (including `test-assets/smartpdf-form.pdf`) plus these 11 synthetic fixtures. The five independent authoring/producer families remain Chrome/Skia, LibreOfficeDev, Quartz/CUPS, Apple PDFKit annotation authoring, and pdf-lib. Synthetic fixtures add structural coverage, not producer-family coverage.
